note: Inputs for tools/design/map/sacred.py. Strengths, reaches and thresholds are first guesses for Formula C's feature data (A_f, R_f, a_f) and the R30 thresholds; the names are given by kind and tile, like place_names.json.

miasma_wasteland.why: Set by hand (R27: the wasteland is authored). The scorched badlands where Thiên Xu, Lạc Hà and Thính Vũ meet: no road, no place within 17 tiles. Without a centre the tool searches for open, poor ground where sects meet.

names.note: Under Thúy Vi Tông. Lam is the mountain haze; thúy vi is the green of a hillside seen through it.
Under Tùng Đào Cung. Poria grows on old pine roots and was said to be pine sap a thousand years under the earth.
Under Băng Tâm Các. The cold light of Vương Xương Linh's ice heart in its jade pot (nhất phiến băng tâm tại ngọc hồ).
Under Lạc Hà Tông. Lý Thanh Chiếu: lạc nhật dung kim, the setting sun melting into gold.
Under Thiên Xu Tông. Tử Vi is the enclosure of the pole star, which the Dipper circles.
Under Phượng Minh Cung. Giả Nghị: the phoenix soars a thousand fathoms and comes down only where it sees the radiance of virtue.
Under Thính Vũ Lâu. Đỗ Phủ's good rain slips in with the night wind and moistens all things without a sound.
A wild vein high in Dao Quang Lĩnh, near Trích Tinh Phong, 4 tiles from Băng Tâm's border.
A wild vein under the old pine sea, 4 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.
Vương Duy: trường hà lạc nhật viên, the long river and the round setting sun. On the border with Thính Vũ.
In Kinh Trập Sơn, the mountains of the thunder that wakes the sleepers; within reach of the storm peaks, so it carries Thunder. 5 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.
Băng phách, the ice soul, is an old name for the moon. Under the ice mountains of Ngọc Hồ Sơn, within reach of the storm peaks.
Under a volcano on an island off Tuyết Hỏa Giác, far out in the western sea, where Lạc Hà's waters begin.
Sơn Hải Kinh's cinnabar mountain is where the phoenix is born. 3 tiles from Thiên Xu's border.
Kinh Thi: phượng hoàng minh hĩ, vu bỉ cao cương, the phoenix sings on that high ridge. A sacred summit (Light).
A shaft into the dark under Ngọc Hành Sơn, a few days' ride from Dạ Quang Môn.
Where the creatures of Kinh Trập Sơn sleep until the spring thunder wakes them.
Huyền Minh is the god of winter and the dark north. A lava tube under a dead volcano of Hàn Sương Châu.
Đỗ Mục: chiết kích trầm sa thiết vị tiêu, a broken halberd sunk in the sand, its iron not yet worn away. Who fought here is for the history (#27).
Tào Tùng: nhất tướng công thành vạn cốt khô, one general's glory, ten thousand bones dried.
